title: [Test] Improve test reuse in test_torch.py for out-of-tree backends [3/N]
body:
## Summary

This PR is part of a series of PRs that incrementally refactor `test_torch.py` to improve test reuse for out-of-tree backends.

It moves backend-implementation tests out of the device-generic `TestTorchDeviceType` into the existing `TestTorchCUDA` class, and moves two device-agnostic tests out of `TestTorchDeviceType` into the plain `TestTorch` class.

## Changes

- Move four CUDA-specific tests from `TestTorchDeviceType` to `TestTorchCUDA`, dropping redundant `@onlyCUDA` decorators:  
  -  `test_zero_dense_emits_memset`  
  -  `test_zero_strided_emits_fill_kernel`  
  -  `test_zero_dense_inside_graph_capture`  
  -  `test_reduced_type_float_copy_emits_vectorized_kernel` 
- Move two device-agnostic tests from `TestTorchDeviceType` to `TestTorch`, dropping `@onlyCPU` and the unused `device` parameter:  
  -  `test_constants`  
  -  `test_warn_always_caught`
